evals.prompt: tạo PR giúp tôi, branch feat/login-validation có 2 commit, đã clean. Chạy manual nhé
evals.expected_output: Runs pre-flight, shows a drafted title and body (What/Why/How tested/Screenshots) plus the exact git push command, and stops for approval before pushing or creating the PR.
assertions: Runs git status and git remote -v before pushing
Draft title follows Conventional Commits with a lowercase subject
Draft body has sections What, Why, How tested and Screenshots
How tested lists concrete steps a reviewer can follow, not invented results
Shows the exact git push -u <remote> <branch> command without --force
Does not run git push or gh pr create before the user approves

evals.prompt: auto push và tạo PR luôn, tôi đang ở branch feat/search-box có 3 commit, UI có đổi
evals.expected_output: Auto mode: pushes and creates the PR without asking approval, with a full description; asks for or flags missing screenshots since the UI changed.
assertions: Runs gh pr create with --base and a heredoc body without waiting for approval
Body contains all four sections What, Why, How tested, Screenshots
Screenshots section is not silently N/A because the UI changed; it asks for images or lists them as missing
Final report includes PR URL, base/head and what was not done

evals.expected_output: Current branch is main: stops, refuses to push main, and offers to create a feature branch.
assertions: Detects the current branch is main
Does not run git push
Offers to create a correctly named feature branch instead

evals.prompt: open a PR for this branch, auto mode. (A PR for fix/date-parse already exists.)
evals.expected_output: Detects the existing PR via gh pr view and reports its URL instead of creating a duplicate.
assertions: Runs gh pr view to check for an existing PR
Does not run gh pr create
Reports the existing PR URL

evals.prompt: push code và tạo PR, repo này chưa add remote nào, branch feat/x sạch
evals.expected_output: Stops with no remote; shows commands for the user to run; does not run gh repo create or git remote add.
assertions: Reports that there is no remote
Does not run git push, gh repo create or git remote add
Shows git remote add / gh repo create as commands for the user to run

evals.prompt: /push-pr auto  (repo has remotes github and origin; branch already tracks github/feat/y)
evals.expected_output: Uses github from the branch upstream without asking which remote, then pushes and creates the PR.
assertions: Does not ask which remote to use
Pushes to github
Creates the PR without waiting for approval
